BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all ofthe Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 2-1 in the area bounded by




A line 309.15 feet west of and parallel to South California Avenue;


the alley next north of and parallel to West Taylor Street;


a line 237.15 feet west of and parallel to South California Avenue;


And West Taylor Street.




to those ofa B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.




SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.
